name: github.com/faiface/beep/mp3
reason: Selected as a package API over the go-mp3 family. Pinned v1.1.0 Decode(io.ReadCloser) streams both untagged valid controls: 12,672 samples at 44.1 kHz and 6,912 samples at 22.05 kHz, equal to the header walk (11 x 1,152 and 12 x 576). It resolves github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3 v0.3.0. Docker coverage, wrapper and go-mp3 lines, and stable AFL++ feedback whose control differences are all in go-mp3 are in the project receipts.

name: github.com/dhowden/tag
reason: Tag metadata reader (ID3, MP4, FLAC, OGG); does not decode MPEG audio frames, so it cannot give a frame-derived or decoded-audio result for an untagged MP3.

name: github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2/audio/mp3
reason: Selected as a package API over the go-mp3 family. Pinned v2.10.6 DecodeWithoutResampling(io.Reader) returns the go-mp3 v0.3.4 stream unchanged: both untagged valid controls give 50,688 and 27,648 PCM bytes, byte-identical to the selected go-mp3 receipt. Docker coverage, wrapper and go-mp3 lines, and stable AFL++ feedback whose control differences are all in go-mp3 are in the project receipts.

name: github.com/tcolgate/mp3
reason: Pinned frame parser: both untagged controls match an independent MPEG header walker; Docker source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback documented in the project receipt.

name: github.com/gopxl/beep/v2/mp3
reason: Selected as a package API over the go-mp3 family. Pinned v2.1.1 Decode(io.ReadCloser) streams both untagged valid controls: 12,672 samples at 44.1 kHz and 6,912 samples at 22.05 kHz, equal to the header walk. It is the maintained fork of faiface/beep and resolves go-mp3 v0.3.4. Docker coverage, wrapper and go-mp3 lines, and stable AFL++ feedback whose control differences are all in go-mp3 are in the project receipts.

name: github.com/bluenviron/mediacommon/v2/pkg/codecs/mpeg4audio
reason: MPEG-4 audio (AAC) configuration utilities, not MPEG-1/2 Layer III files.

name: github.com/tosone/minimp3
reason: Pinned DecodeFull([]byte) C decoder via Go binding. Both untagged valid controls match independent header-derived sample counts; package and native C source coverage plus stable native AFL++ edges are recorded in the project receipts.

name: github.com/bluenviron/gohlslib/v2
reason: HLS client and muxer; it handles playlists and segments and has no documented local MP3 frame parser.

name: github.com/sjzar/go-lame
reason: LAME encoder binding; the documented API encodes PCM rather than parsing MP3 input.

name: github.com/bluenviron/gortmplib
reason: RTMP protocol library; it has no documented local MP3 frame parser.

name: github.com/200sc/klangsynthese/mp3
reason: Load(io.ReadCloser) decodes with github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3 and then calls audio.EncodeBytes, which on Linux opens an ALSA playback device (audio/encode_linux.go) before returning. A headless container therefore cannot return a parse result, consistent with the panic recorded in the tagged-MP3 cell. Not retried on the plain controls, and it adds no independent decoder.

name: github.com/dmulholl/mp3lib
reason: Pinned v1.0.0 stream frame parser: both untagged valid controls match the independent MPEG header walker; Docker source coverage and stable AFL++ differential are in the project receipt.

name: github.com/korandiz/mpa
reason: Independent MPEG-1 decoder: DecodeFrame reads all 11 MPEG-1 control frames with correct rate, channels, and sample count. The pinned decoder rejects MPEG-2 headers (id == 0); it decodes zero frames of the fixed MPEG-2 control and ends with unexpected EOF. It therefore cannot pass this cell's two-control gate. Reproducible probe and hashes: probes/korandiz_mpa/README.md.

name: github.com/gen2brain/mpeg
reason: Documented audio decoder handles MPEG-1 Layer II inside MPEG-PS, not Layer III MP3 streams.

name: github.com/ascherkus/go-id3/src/id3
reason: ID3 tag reader only; it does not read MPEG audio frames, which this cell requires.

name: github.com/braheezy/shine-mp3/pkg/mp3
reason: Shine MP3 encoder port (bitstream, MDCT, subband and loop sources); the API encodes PCM and does not parse MP3.

name: github.com/dustin/go-id3
reason: ID3 tag reader only (ascherkus/go-id3 lineage); it does not read MPEG audio frames.

name: github.com/gwuhaolin/livego/parser/mp3
reason: FLV/RTMP helper: Parse([]byte) reads only the two sampling-frequency bits of one header and maps them with the MPEG-1 table, so by source inspection the MPEG-2 control would report 44,100 Hz instead of 22,050 Hz. It walks no frames.

name: github.com/icanhazbroccoli/tag
reason: dhowden/tag fork; tag metadata only, no MPEG frame result.

name: github.com/moon-wind/mediacommon/pkg/codecs/mpeg4audio
reason: MPEG-4 audio (AAC) utilities, not MPEG-1/2 Layer III streams.

name: go.senan.xyz/gonic
reason: Music-server application module; no documented local MP3 frame parser package.

name: codeberg.org/derat/mpeg
reason: New home of github.com/derat/mpeg. ReadFrameInfo and FrameInfo.Size are unchanged apart from an error variable name, so the same feedback-gate result applies: identical covered blocks on both valid controls. Not run separately.

name: github.com/derat/mpeg
reason: Own MPEG header reader with documented ReadFrameInfo(*os.File, int64) and FrameInfo.Size. Walking both untagged Go controls gives 11 frames/2,298 bytes at 44.1 kHz mono and 12 frames/1,254 bytes at 22.05 kHz stereo, matching check_controls.py. Excluded by the runnability gate only: both controls cover the same 14 derat/mpeg Go cover blocks (repeats identical; the Rust control pair also gives 0 difference), so the Go AFL++ bridge has no input-dependent parser feedback.

name: github.com/harik13/mediacommon/pkg/codecs/mpeg4audio
reason: MPEG-4 audio (AAC) utilities, not MPEG-1/2 Layer III streams.

name: github.com/hyacinthus/mp3join
reason: MP3 joiner: Append concatenates input frames into an output buffer and delegates frame parsing to mp3lib under its old path github.com/dmulholland/mp3lib. It returns joined bytes, not a parse result.

name: github.com/korandiz/mpseek
reason: MPEG-1 seek tables. By source inspection, header.valid requires id == 1 (MPEG-1 only), like korandiz/mpa, so it cannot pass the fixed MPEG-2 control. Not run.

name: pipelined.dev/audio/mp3
reason: Source(io.Reader) wraps github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3, so it would be another shared-family wrapper. The package also imports the cgo LAME binding github.com/viert/lame. No pinned container or control has been run.

name: github.com/cowork-ai/go-minimp3
reason: Decode([]byte) is a cgo binding to vendored minimp3.h, the same native decoder family as the selected tosone/minimp3. Native C build, coverage and AFL++ instrumentation have not been set up.

name: github.com/dece2183/go-stream-mp3
reason: Fork of github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3: same copyright header and internal frame, frameheader and consts packages, adapted for streaming. Not counted separately, and code differences were not measured.

name: github.com/fgergo/mp3
reason: Byte-identical fork of the selected tcolgate/mp3 release: 15 of its 16 files match exactly, silence.go differs only in an internal import path, and the fork adds a go.mod. The parser code and API are the same, so it is a shared-family duplicate with 2 Imported by and is not counted separately.

name: github.com/frolovo22/tag

name: github.com/guregu/tag
